articles.title: Average Is Over
articles.topic: 平庸时代的终结：全球化与技术革命重塑就业
articles.source: 2013 年考研英语（二）Text 1 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: In an essay entitled "Making It in America," the author Adam Davidson relates a joke from cotton country about just how much a modern textile mill has been automated: the average mill has only two employees today, "a man and a dog."
sentences.cn: 《在美国制造》一文中，作者亚当·戴维森讲述了一个来自棉花产地、有关现代纺织厂自动化到达何种程度的笑话：普通纺织厂如今只有两名员工，“一个人和一只狗”。

sentences.en: The man is there to feed the dog, and the dog is there to keep the man away from the machines.
sentences.cn: 人负责喂狗，而狗负责让人远离机器。

sentences.en: Davidson's article is one of a number of pieces that have recently appeared making the point that the reason we have such stubbornly high unemployment and declining middle-class incomes today is largely because of the big drop in demand because of the Great Recession, but it is also because of the advances in both globalization and the information technology revolution, which are more rapidly than ever replacing labor with machines or foreign workers.
sentences.cn: 戴维森此文只不过是新近涌现的诸多同类文章中的一篇，这些文章都提出这样一种观点：当前失业率居高不下以及中产阶级收入缩水，很大程度上是由于大萧条造成的需求大幅降低，但同时也由于全球化和信息技术革命的发展，这种发展使机器或外国工人取代劳动力的速度超过了以往任何时期。

sentences.en: In the past, workers with average skills, doing an average job, could earn an average lifestyle.
sentences.cn: 过去，劳动者拥有一般技能，干一份普通工作，就能过上普通生活。

sentences.en: But, today, average is officially over.
sentences.cn: 但是现在，“平庸”已正式结束。

sentences.en: Being average just won't earn you what it used to.
sentences.cn: 表现平平完全无法再让你过上普通生活了。

sentences.en: It can't when so many more employers have so much more access to so much more above average cheap foreign labor, cheap robotics, cheap software, cheap automation and cheap genius.
sentences.cn: 当如此多得多的雇主有着如此多得多的渠道获取如此多得多中等以上水平的廉价外国劳力、廉价机器人、廉价软件、廉价自动装置以及廉价天才的时候，表现普通将难以立足。

sentences.en: Therefore, everyone needs to find their extra - their unique value contribution that makes them stand out in whatever is their field of employment.
sentences.cn: 因此，所有人都需要找到自身的额外价值——一种可以令其在各种工作领域中脱颖而出的独特价值贡献。

sentences.en: Yes, new technology has been eating jobs forever, and always will.
sentences.cn: 的确，新技术一直在吞噬工作岗位，而且将永远持续下去。

sentences.en: But there's been an acceleration.
sentences.cn: 不过速度一直在加快。

sentences.en: As Davidson notes, "In the 10 years ending in 2009, [U.S.] factories shed workers so fast that they erased almost all the gains of the previous 70 years; roughly one out of every three manufacturing jobs - about 6 million in total - disappeared."
sentences.cn: 正如戴维森所言，“2009 年以前的十年间，（美国）工厂裁员如此之快，以至于抹掉了前 70 年所有新增员工的总额；制造业岗位中，大约有三分之一，共计将近 600 万个岗位不复存在。”

sentences.en: There will always be change - new jobs, new products, new services.
sentences.cn: 变化将会永远存在——新岗位，新产品，新服务。

sentences.en: But the one thing we know for sure is that with each advance in globalization and the I.T. revolution, the best jobs will require workers to have more and better education to make themselves above average.
sentences.cn: 但有一点我们确信无疑，随着全球化和信息技术革命的发展，最佳岗位将要求员工掌握更多、更好的教育，以使自己高于平均水平。

sentences.en: In a world where average is officially over, there are many things we need to do to support employment, but nothing would be more important than passing some kind of G.I. Bill for the 21st century that ensures that every American has access to post-high school education.
sentences.cn: 在一个已正式告别平庸的世界里，我们需要做很多事情以扶持就业，但对 21 世纪来讲，最重要的事情莫过于出台《美国退伍军人权利法案》之类的法案，以确保每个美国人都有机会接受高中后教育。

questions.stem: The joke in Paragraph 1 is used to illustrate ___
questions.stem_cn: 第一段中的笑话被用来说明 ___
questions.explanation: 首段引述笑话是为了说明现代纺织厂高度自动化，即技术进步的影响，A 正确。B、C、D 均为对笑话字面的误读，非其用意。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 3, to be a successful employee, one has to ___
questions.stem_cn: 根据第三段，要成为成功的员工，必须 ___
questions.explanation: 第三段末句以 Therefore 总结：个人须找到自己的独特价值贡献（find their extra – their unique value contribution），D 为同义改写。A 为雇主的工具；B、C 与雇员成功无关。

questions.stem: The quotation in Paragraph 4 explains that ___
questions.stem_cn: 第四段中的引语说明 ___

options.A: gains of technology have been erased
options.B: job opportunities are disappearing at a high speed
options.C: factories are making much less money than before
options.D: new jobs and services have been offered

options_cn.A: 技术带来的收益已被抹去
options_cn.B: 工作机会正在高速消失
options_cn.C: 工厂比以前赚得少得多
options_cn.D: 已提供新的工作和服务

questions.explanation: 引语指出工厂裁员之快抹去前 70 年增长，制造业岗位每三个消失一个，约 600 万岗位消失，说明工作机会高速消失，B 正确。A 断章取义；C、D 无据。

questions.stem: According to the author, to reduce unemployment, the most important is ___
questions.stem_cn: 作者认为，要减少失业，最重要的是 ___

options.B: to ensure more education for people
options.D: to pass more bills in the 21st century

options_cn.B: 确保人们接受更多教育
options_cn.D: 在 21 世纪通过更多法案

questions.explanation: 末段指出最重要的是通过《退伍军人权利法案》式的法案，确保每个美国人接受高中后教育，B 正确。A、C 是造成失业的原因；D 曲解原文（重点是教育而非法案数量）。

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the most appropriate title for the text?
questions.stem_cn: 下列哪项最适合作本文标题？
questions.explanation: 全文主旨为平庸年代已结束，须创造独特价值以应对就业难题，C 正确。A、B、D 均为文中细节或次要信息，不能概括主旨。

articles.title: Birds of Passage
articles.topic: 候鸟式移民：重新看待美国移民体制
articles.source: 2013 年考研英语（二）Text 2 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: A century ago, the immigrants from across the Atlantic included settlers and sojourners.
sentences.cn: 一个世纪前，横跨大西洋来到美国的移民中既有定居者，也有旅居者。

sentences.en: Along with the many folks looking to make a permanent home in the United States came those who had no intention to stay, and who would make some money and then go home.
sentences.cn: 许多人希望在美国建立永久家园，但也有人无意长留于此，打算赚些钱后返回家乡。

sentences.en: Between 1908 and 1915, about 7 million people arrived while about 2 million departed.
sentences.cn: 1908 年至 1915 年间，约有 700 万人来到美国，而离开的大约有 200 万人。

sentences.en: About a quarter of all Italian immigrants, for example, eventually returned to Italy for good.
sentences.cn: 例如，约有四分之一的意大利移民最终永久返回了意大利。

sentences.en: They even had an affectionate nickname, "uccelli di passaggio," birds of passage.
sentences.cn: 他们甚至有个亲切的昵称，“uccelli di passaggio”，即“候鸟”。

sentences.en: Today, we are much more rigid about immigrants.
sentences.cn: 今天，我们对移民严格了许多。

sentences.en: We divide newcomers into two categories: legal or illegal, good or bad.
sentences.cn: 我们将新来者分为两类：合法或非法，好或坏。

sentences.en: We hail them as Americans in the making, or brand them as aliens to be kicked out.
sentences.cn: 我们或将其誉为“缔造中的美国人”，或将其归为“需要驱逐的异族”。

sentences.en: That framework has contributed mightily to our broken immigration system and the long political paralysis over how to fix it.
sentences.cn: 这一思维构架在很大程度上导致了我们的移民体系漏洞百出，也致使政府对“如何修复这一体系”处于长期瘫痪状态。

sentences.en: We don't need more categories, but we need to change the way we think about categories.
sentences.cn: 我们无需更多类别，但需要改变对类别的思考方式。

sentences.en: We need to look beyond strict definitions of legal and illegal.
sentences.cn: 我们需要超越对“合法”和“非法”的严格定义。

sentences.en: To start, we can recognize the new birds of passage, those living and thriving in the gray areas.
sentences.cn: 首先，我们可以认可那些“新候鸟”，那些于灰色地带生活并繁荣发展的人。

sentences.en: We might then begin to solve our immigration challenges.
sentences.cn: 之后，我们才有可能着手解决在移民方面面临的挑战。

sentences.en: Crop pickers, violinists, construction workers, entrepreneurs, engineers, home health-care aides and physicists are among today's birds of passage.
sentences.cn: 如今的“候鸟”中，有农作物收割工、小提琴手、建筑工人、企业家、工程师、家庭医疗保健助手以及物理学家等。

sentences.en: They are energetic participants in a global economy driven by the flow of work, money and ideas.
sentences.cn: 受工作、资金以及观念流动的驱使，他们成为全球经济的积极参与者。

sentences.en: They prefer to come and go as opportunity calls them.
sentences.cn: 他们愿意跟随机会的召唤或来或走。

sentences.en: They can manage to have a job in one place and a family in another.
sentences.cn: 他们可以设法在一个地方工作，在另一个地方安家。

sentences.en: With or without permission, they straddle laws, jurisdictions and identities with ease.
sentences.cn: 不管有无许可，他们都能轻松跨越法律、管辖区域以及身份。

sentences.en: We need them to imagine the United States as a place where they can be productive for a while without committing themselves to staying forever.
sentences.cn: 我们需要他们将美国视作一个能让他们有所成就而无需承诺永久居住的地方。

sentences.en: We need them to feel that home can be both here and there and that they can belong to two nations honorably.
sentences.cn: 我们需要他们感觉到既可以在美国安家、也可以在祖国安家，他们可以体面地属于两个国家。

sentences.en: Accommodating this new world of people in motion will require new attitudes on both sides of the immigration battle.
sentences.cn: 认可这样一个流动人员的新世界，需要“移民之争”双方都有新的态度。

sentences.en: Looking beyond the culture war logic of right or wrong means opening up the middle ground and understanding that managing immigration today requires multiple paths and multiple outcomes, including some that are not easy to accomplish legally in the existing system.
sentences.cn: 超越这种非对即错文化战争的逻辑，意味着要打开中间地带，并知晓当今的移民管理需要多种途径及多样结果，包括一些现有制度下通过法律难以达成的途径和结果。

questions.stem: "Birds of passage" refers to those who ___
questions.stem_cn: “候鸟”指的是那些 ___ 的人

options.A: stay in a foreign country temporarily
options.B: leave their home countries for good

questions.explanation: birds of passage 首次出现在第一段末句，与前文无意久留、赚钱后回国的意大利移民同指，即无意在国外定居的人，A 正确。B 与“候鸟”含义相悖；C 范围过宽（含定居者）；D 与永久相反。

questions.stem: It is implied in Paragraph 2 that the current immigration system in the US ___
questions.stem_cn: 第二段暗示美国现行移民体制 ___

options.C: should be adapted to meet challenges
options.D: has been fixed via political means

options_cn.C: 应做出调整以迎接挑战

questions.explanation: 第二段指出现行政策过于严格，须超越合法与非法的严格定义、认可灰色地带的候鸟，方能应对移民挑战；rigid、broken、paralysis 等贬义词也表明批评态度，C 符合。A 反向；B 与 rigid 相反；D 曲解 paralysis。

questions.stem: According to the author, today's birds of passage want ___
questions.stem_cn: 作者认为，现今的候鸟想要 ___

options.C: the freedom to stay and leave

questions.explanation: 第三段指出候鸟愿随机会召唤而或来或走（prefer to come and go as opportunity calls them），C 同义改写。A 断章取义 money；B 曲解 energetic participants；D 与来去自由相悖。

questions.stem: The author suggests that the birds of passage today should be treated ___
questions.stem_cn: 作者建议现今的候鸟应被 ___ 对待
questions.explanation: 作者主张承认灰色地带的候鸟、打开中间地带、以多种途径管理（含现有体制内难以合法达成者），实即在法律上给予更多包容，B 正确。A 中 faithful 有悖文意；C 属过度引申；D 完全违背作者态度。

questions.stem: The most appropriate title for this text would be ___
questions.stem_cn: 本文最恰当的标题为 ___
questions.explanation: 全文主旨为：将移民严格分为合法或非法非常错误，应予调整，D 正确。Legal or Illegal 概括现行体制，Big Mistake 表明批评态度。A 违背作者观点；B、C 为细节或干扰。

articles.title: Slow Down Your Snap Decisions
articles.topic: 快速决策与理性权衡：人类能扭转本能反应
articles.source: 2013 年考研英语（二）Text 3 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: Scientists have found that although we are prone to snap overreactions, if we take a moment and think about how we are likely to react, we can reduce or even eliminate the negative effects of our quick, hard-wired responses.
sentences.cn: 科学家已经发现：我们虽然易于做出快速过激反应，但是，如果花点时间揣度一下我们可能会做何反应，就可以减少甚至消除快速本能反应的负面影响。

words.meaning: adj. 天生固定的，硬性的

sentences.en: Snap decisions can be important defense mechanisms; if we are judging whether someone is dangerous, our brains and bodies are hard-wired to react very quickly, within milliseconds.
sentences.cn: 快速决策可能是重要防御机制；如果要判断某人是否具有危险性，毫秒间我们的大脑和身体就会本能地快速做出反应。

sentences.en: But we need more time to assess other factors.
sentences.cn: 但是，我们需要更多时间来评定其他因素。

sentences.en: To accurately tell whether someone is sociable, studies show, we need at least a minute, preferably five.
sentences.cn: 研究表明：要准确辨别某人是否好交际，我们至少需要一分钟，五分钟会更好。

sentences.en: It takes a while to judge complex aspects of personality, like neuroticism or open-mindedness.
sentences.cn: 想要判断某人性格的复杂方面，如神经过敏或思想开明，则需要花上一段时间。

sentences.en: But snap decisions in reaction to rapid stimuli aren't exclusive to the interpersonal realm.
sentences.cn: 但是，因瞬间刺激而做出快速决策并不专属于人际范畴。

sentences.en: Psychologists at the University of Toronto found that viewing a fast-food logo for just a few milliseconds primes us to read 20 percent faster, even though reading has little to do with eating.
sentences.cn: 多伦多大学的心理学家发现，即便阅读和进餐没什么关系，但只看几毫秒的快餐标识就会促使我们将阅读速度加快 20%。

words.meaning: 使我们倾向于，预先引导

sentences.en: We unconsciously associate fast food with speed and impatience and carry those impulses into whatever else we're doing.
sentences.cn: 我们会不自觉地将快餐与速度和急躁联系起来，并把这些冲动带入我们正在做的任何其他事情中。

sentences.en: Subjects exposed to fast-food flashes also tend to think a musical piece lasts too long.
sentences.cn: 那些看过快餐图像闪现的受试者也倾向于认为一段音乐持续得太久了。

sentences.en: Yet we can reverse such influences.
sentences.cn: 然而，我们可以扭转这些影响。

sentences.en: If we know we will overreact to consumer products or housing options when we see a happy face (one reason good sales representatives and real estate agents are always smiling), we can take a moment before buying.
sentences.cn: 如果我们知道，自己在选择消费品或房屋时看见笑脸会做出过度反应（这是优秀销售代理和不动产代理总是面带笑容的理由之一），就可以在购买之前等一等。

sentences.en: If we know female job screeners are more likely to reject attractive female applicants, we can help screeners understand their biases - or hire outside screeners.
sentences.cn: 如果我们知道，女性招聘官更可能拒绝有魅力的女求职者，就可以帮助招聘官们认识自己的偏见——或是聘请外部招聘官。

sentences.en: John Gottman, the marriage expert, explains that we quickly "thin slice" information reliably only after we ground such snap reactions in "thick sliced" long-term study.
sentences.cn: 婚姻专家约翰·戈特曼解释道，只有在将这种快速反应建立于“厚片”长期研究的基础上之后，我们才能可靠而又快速地汲取“薄片”信息。

words.meaning: 薄片（快速截取少量信息作判断）
将这些快速反应建立在……基础上

sentences.en: When Dr. Gottman really wants to assess whether a couple will stay together, he invites them to his island retreat for a much longer evaluation: two days, not two seconds.
sentences.cn: 当戈特曼博士真想评定夫妻俩是否会共同生活时，他会邀请他们去他岛上的静养处进行更长时间的评估：是两天，而非两秒。

sentences.en: Our ability to mute our hard-wired reactions by pausing is what differentiates us from animals: dogs can think about the future only intermittently or for a few minutes.
sentences.cn: 通过暂停来减缓本能反应的能力使得我们有别于动物：狗只能间歇地或是持续几分钟来思考未来。

sentences.en: But historically we have spent about 12 percent of our days contemplating the longer term.
sentences.cn: 但是，从历史上看来，我们大约花费 12% 的时间来思索更长远的未来。

sentences.en: Although technology might change the way we react, it hasn't changed our nature.
sentences.cn: 尽管科技可能改变我们的反应方式，但它还没有改变我们的天性。

sentences.en: We still have the imaginative capacity to rise above temptation and reverse the high-speed trend.
sentences.cn: 我们仍然具有丰富的想象能力，去超越诱惑、扭转快速趋向。

questions.stem: The time needed in making decisions may ___
questions.stem_cn: 做决定所需的时间可能 ___

options.A: predetermine the accuracy of our judgment
options.B: prove the complexity of our brain reaction
options.C: depend on the importance of the assessment
options.D: vary according to the urgency of the situation

options_cn.A: 预先决定我们判断的准确性
options_cn.B: 证明我们大脑反应的复杂性
options_cn.D: 因情况的紧急程度而异

questions.explanation: 第二段指出：判断危险时大脑会在毫秒内反应，而判断其他更复杂的方面则需要更多时间。可见紧急情况不同，决定所需时间不同，D 正确。A、B、C 均无文中依据。

questions.stem: Our reaction to a fast-food logo shows that snap decisions ___
questions.stem_cn: 我们对快餐图标的反应表明快速决策 ___
questions.explanation: 第三段指出，人们无意识地将快餐与速度、不耐烦联系，并把这些冲动带入其他事情，表明快速决策具有联想传导性，A 正确。B 与无意识关联相反；C、D 无据。

questions.stem: To reverse the negative influences of snap decisions, we should ___
questions.stem_cn: 要扭转快速决策的负面影响，我们应 ___

options_cn.C: 照人们的通常做法去做

questions.explanation: 第四段以例子说明：知道销售员的微笑会促使我们冲动购物，就可以在购买前多想一想，可见“想好再行动”能消除负面影响，B 正确。A 与文意相反；C 望文生义；D 以末段事实干扰。

questions.stem: John Gottman says that reliable snap reactions are based on ___
questions.stem_cn: 约翰·戈特曼说，可靠的快速反应基于 ___
questions.explanation: 戈特曼指出，只有将快速反应建立在“厚片”长期研究（thick sliced long-term study）基础上，快速反应才可靠；thick sliced 即充分信息，C 正确。B 恰恰相反（thin sliced 是结果而非基础）；A、D 无据。

questions.stem: The author's attitude toward reversing the high-speed trend is ___
questions.stem_cn: 作者对扭转高速趋势的态度是 ___
questions.explanation: 末段指出技术未改变人的本性，我们仍拥有想象力可超越诱惑、扭转高速趋势，可见作者认为这是有希望做到的，持乐观态度，B 正确。

articles.title: Quotas for Women on Corporate Boards
articles.topic: 女性董事配额之争：通往平等的强制手段
articles.source: 2013 年考研英语（二）Text 4 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: Europe is not a gender-equality heaven.
sentences.cn: 欧洲并非性别平等的天堂。

sentences.en: In particular, the corporate workplace will never be completely family-friendly until women are part of senior management decisions, and Europe's top corporate-governance positions remain overwhelmingly male.
sentences.cn: 特别是，除非女性能参与高层管理决策，否则职场永远不会完全成为家庭友好型场所，而欧洲的企业管理高层职位仍然是男性占据绝对多数。

words.meaning: adv. 压倒性地，绝大多数地

sentences.en: Indeed, women hold only 14 per cent of positions on European corporate boards.
sentences.cn: 事实上，女性仅占欧洲企业董事会职位的 14%。

sentences.en: The European Union is now considering legislation to compel corporate boards to maintain a certain proportion of women - up to 60 per cent.
sentences.cn: 欧盟正考虑立法，强迫公司董事会保有一定比例的女性——该比例可高达 60%。

sentences.en: This proposed mandate was born of frustration.
sentences.cn: 此强制性提议源于一次挫折。

sentences.en: Last year, European Commission Vice President Viviane Reding issued a call to voluntary action.
sentences.cn: 去年，欧盟委员会副主席薇薇安·瑞丁发起了一项自愿活动的号召。

sentences.en: Reding invited corporations to sign up for gender balance goals of 40 per cent female board membership.
sentences.cn: 瑞丁邀请各企业参与实现“女性在董事会中占 40%”这一性别平衡目标。

sentences.en: But her appeal was considered a failure: only 24 companies took it up.
sentences.cn: 但她的呼吁被认为是失败的：只有 24 家公司接受其呼吁。

sentences.en: Do we need quotas to ensure that women can continue to climb the corporate ladder fairly as they balance work and family?
sentences.cn: 我们真的需要定额来确保女性在平衡工作和家庭的同时能继续公平地攀爬企业晋升阶梯吗？

sentences.en: "Personally, I don't like quotas," Reding said recently.
sentences.cn: 瑞丁最近表示：“就我个人而言，我不喜欢定额。”

sentences.en: "But I like what the quotas do."
sentences.cn: “但我喜欢定额所起的作用。”

sentences.en: Quotas get action: they "open the way to equality and they break through the glass ceiling," according to Reding, a result seen in France and other countries with legally binding provisions on placing women in top business positions.
sentences.cn: 瑞丁认为，定额能带来行动：它们“为平等开辟了道路，并打破了玻璃天花板”，这一结果已在法国以及其他对女性担任企业高层职位有法律约束性规定的国家中得到印证。

words.meaning: 打破玻璃天花板（无形晋升障碍）

sentences.en: I understand Reding's reluctance - and her frustration.
sentences.cn: 我理解瑞丁的不情愿——还有她的挫败感。

sentences.en: I don't like quotas either; they run counter to my belief in meritocracy, governance by the capable.
sentences.cn: 我也不喜欢定额；它们有悖于我所信仰的英才制度，即能者居之。

sentences.en: But, when one considers the obstacles to achieving the meritocratic ideal, it does look as if a fairer world must be temporarily ordered.
sentences.cn: 但考虑到实现英才制度这一理想所面临的诸多障碍，确实看起来必须暂时实施强制管理才能让世界变得更公平。

sentences.en: After all, four decades of evidence has now shown that corporations in Europe as well as the US are evading the meritocratic hiring and promotion of women to top positions - no matter how much "soft pressure" is put upon them.
sentences.cn: 毕竟，四十年的证据现已表明，不管给它们施加多少“软压力”，欧洲以及美国的企业都在逃避精英选才，拒绝升迁女性到高层。

sentences.en: When women do break through to the summit of corporate power - as, for example, Sheryl Sandberg recently did at Facebook - they attract massive attention precisely because they remain the exception to the rule.
sentences.cn: 当女性确实打入公司权力高层时——例如，就像雪莉·桑德伯格最近在脸书所做的那样——她们会吸引大量关注，而这恰恰是因为她们仍然属于规则中的例外。

sentences.en: If appropriate public policies were in place to help all women - whether CEOs or their children's caregivers - and all families, Sandberg would be no more newsworthy than any other highly capable person living in a more just society.
sentences.cn: 如果能够制定适当的公共政策来帮助所有女性——无论是公司高管还是她们孩子的护工——以及所有家庭，那么在这样一个更公平的社会，桑德伯格就不会比任何其他卓越人士更具报道价值。

questions.stem: In the European corporate workplace, generally ___
questions.stem_cn: 在欧洲企业职场中，通常 ___
questions.explanation: 第一段指出欧洲最高层的公司治理职位仍然绝大多数由男性占据，女性仅占董事会 14%，可见男性掌握决策权，B 正确。A 与文意相反；C、D 无据。

questions.stem: The European Union's intended legislation is ___
questions.stem_cn: 欧盟拟制定的立法是 ___
questions.explanation: 第二段指出：欧盟立法源于挫折，因“呼吁自愿参与”无效（仅 24 家公司响应），才考虑“立法强制执行”，实乃不得已而为之，C 正确。A 混淆逻辑关系；B 曲解二者关系；D 张冠李戴（自愿行动指瑞丁呼吁）。

questions.stem: According to Reding, quotas may help women ___
questions.stem_cn: 在瑞丁看来，配额可以帮助女性 ___
questions.explanation: 第四段瑞丁观点：配额可开辟通往平等之路、打破晋升障碍，法国等国即为例证；A 是对“打破玻璃天花板”这一抽象信息的直观表达，A 正确。B 因 glass ceiling 字面义干扰；C 以第三段干扰；D 无据。

questions.stem: The author's attitude toward Reding's appeal is one of ___
questions.stem_cn: 作者对瑞丁呼吁的态度是 ___
questions.explanation: 第五段作者表示理解瑞丁的不情愿与挫败感，并指出尽管自己也不喜欢配额，但为实现更公平的世界必须暂时强制，可见作者认同瑞丁的主张，D 正确。

questions.stem: Women entering top management become headlines due to the lack of ___
questions.stem_cn: 女性进入管理高层成为新闻头条，是由于缺乏 ___
questions.explanation: 末段以虚拟句反向表明：假如有合适的公共政策帮助女性和家庭，女高管就不会如此具有新闻价值，可见其轰动原因是缺乏合适的公共政策，C 正确。A 过于抽象；B 与原文逻辑矛盾；D 反向干扰（是软压力无效而非缺乏）。
